title: CLYX Agency
tagline: Marketing and web development agency site presenting brand, product, and web work.
overview: The public website for CLYX, the agency behind Clyx Order and related client work — built to present services, past projects, and a path to contact for new business.
problem: CLYX needed a fast, credible web presence that reflected the same product quality as the platforms it builds, instead of a generic template site.
solution: A React and Vite single-page site with Tailwind CSS, built for speed and clean section-based storytelling: services, selected work, and a direct contact path.
architecture: Vite-powered React app with component-based sections, deployed as a static build for fast global delivery with no backend dependency.
features: Service breakdown across web, mobile, and backend development
Project showcase linking to live client work
Responsive layout tuned for both desktop presentations and mobile visits
Contact flow routing directly to WhatsApp and email
challenges: Communicating technical credibility to a non-technical audience (restaurant and small business owners) without over-explaining the stack
Keeping the single-page build fast despite multiple image-heavy sections
lessonsLearned: A focused one-page site with a clear contact path converts better for local business clients than a multi-page corporate structure
futureImprovements: Case study pages for individual client projects
Lightweight CMS so non-technical team members can update project listings
results: Serves as the primary web presence and contact channel for new CLYX client work
